subject: Readiness scan: short questionnaire + evidence bucket — next steps

From: Ella Smith <ella.smith@auditpartners.com>

Cc: audits@novahealth.com, security@novahealth.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Readiness scan: short questionnaire + evidence ask

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick intake yesterday. As part of NovaHealth's readiness scan we want to do a lightweight questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ + a few SOC 2 probes) and surface any immediate evidence gaps that would block a FedRAMP Low/Moderate path.

Can you confirm the following items by EOD Monday?
- Primary evidence owner + backup for SOC 2 control narrative and logs (who will own the sample pull?)
- Whether you have an ISO 27001 certificate in place today and the expected target date if not
- Any current controls that depend on vendor attestations (KMS, WAF, DB encryption key ops)

If you can attach a small index (name + path) for the most recent artifacts (system configs, retention policies, SOC 2 in-progress notes), that will help us scope the questionnaire.

We expect the questionnaire to be light (10–15 targeted asks) and will use it to produce a gap bucket for NovaHealth's compliance team.

Best,
Ella
Ella Smith
Principal, Audit Partnerships
Audit Partners LLC

Hi Ella — thanks, we can cover that. Quick answers inline and an attachment with a preliminary index.

- Evidence owners:
  - SOC 2 control narratives / sample pulls: David Kim (primary) / Grace O'Connor (backup)
  - ISO artifacts and policy owners: Grace O'Connor
  - Network/infra attestations: Vendor team (contact details in the index)

- ISO 27001: we do not have the certificate today. Target for certification (if all goes per plan) is Q3 2027; we have an internal gap-remediation timeline running now.

- Vendor-dependent controls: KMS (KeySafe Inc., attestation due Q2), CDN/WAF (EdgeWave; SOC2 report available), Database encryption keys managed via KMS (see index).

Attached: redwood_evidence_index_v0.2.csv (list of artifact names, owners, and Drive paths). I propose a 30-minute sync early next week to walk the questionnaire scope and where to pull samples.

Sofia Ivanova

Ella / Sofia — adding a few clarifications from engineering and attaching the evidence matrix.

- SOC 2: we have most evidence staged; engineering has completed control narratives for change management, access controls, and logging. We expect the external SOC 2 assessment to start in June 2027 (in-flight).
- Logs: retention default is 90 days for application logs, 365 days for audit logs (configurable per-customer; NovaHealth is on default). For FedRAMP Moderate we'd need to extend archival and demonstrate immutable retention — that work is on the FedRAMP readiness track.
- ISO timeline: we have a gap remediation plan and quarterly milestones. Q3 2027 is our current optimistic target for certificate.

Attachment: evidence_matrix_v0.3.xlsx — includes owners, paths, and sampling notes. Drive folder link in the matrix for sample extraction scripts.

Happy to join the sync to walk sample locations.

-David
David Kim
Director, Cloud Security Operations — Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.ai

Thanks — a couple follow-ups from NovaHealth security:

- For FedRAMP: can you confirm whether log export supports WORM (write once) for the 365-day audit retention requirement? We need to know if additional tooling will be necessary.
- For SOC 2 sampling: will binaries/snapshots be required, or are config manifests + pipeline runbook extracts sufficient?
- Please flag any control that relies on third-party attestations we must re-evaluate for our supply chain checks (we already flagged KMS and CDN).

If it's easier, we can have a short triage with the engineering team Monday afternoon.

— NovaHealth Audits
